ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels versus 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields on both lobes. Left lobe features a white field bounded by dark pigment on the outer and basal margins. Right lobe features a white field with a dark vertical pigment streak near the interior edge. Dark mottling is present at the pigment interfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration. Prominent jagged peaks and valleys are concentrated on the distal tips, with continuous smaller-scale variations along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the trailing edge of both lobes, culminating in upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint dark diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle accumulation on the distal tips of both lobes, creating a shredded edge appearance.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark pigment island and fine spotting localized within the upper-central region of the left lobe's white field.
